title: Migas for the Crew
subtitle: Scrambled eggs with crispy tortilla strips, peppers, and queso fresco.
description: Crispy tortilla strips scrambled with eggs, peppers, and cheese — Texas migas scaled for the whole hall with salsa on the side.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Migas for the Crew in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Eggs. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Fry tortilla strips
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high until shimmering. Fry tortilla strips in batches until golden and crisp, about 2 minutes per batch. Drain on paper towels and season lightly with salt.

steps.title: Sauté peppers and onion
steps.instruction: Remove all but 2 tablespoons oil from the pan. Sauté poblano and onion over medium-high until softened and lightly charred at the edges, about 5 minutes. Add tomato and cumin; cook 1 minute.

steps.title: Scramble eggs into the mix
steps.instruction: Beat eggs with salt and pepper. Pour into the skillet over medium-low heat, folding gently with a spatula. When eggs are halfway set, fold in half the tortilla strips so some stay crisp and some soften.

steps.title: Finish and garnish
steps.instruction: Remove from heat while eggs still look glossy. Fold in remaining tortilla strips for crunch. Scatter queso fresco and cilantro over the top.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-service, cover finished food and hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven — never leave proteins below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Note the hold time on the pan with a grease pencil.

steps.title: Serve family-style
steps.instruction: Serve straight from the skillet with warm salsa and extra tortilla strips on the side. Do not hold more than 5 minutes or crisp strips will steam soft.

stationWorkflow: Fry tortilla strips first and hold uncovered—covering traps steam and kills crunch.
Use two skillets if feeding ten so eggs finish in one batch without overcooking.
Prep all veg dice before the first tortilla hits oil so the scramble moves fast.
cleanupNotes: Strain and save fry oil if clean; wipe skillet while warm to remove stuck tortilla bits.
Sweep tortilla crumbs from prep surfaces before switching to egg service.
leftovers: Migas do not reheat well; scale the recipe down rather than cooking extra.
Use leftover tortilla strips as crunchy topping for soup or salad at lunch.
